subject: Syndicated promo credit runbook request — LatticeCloud co-sell
messages:
From: Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — Alice from LatticeCloud here. We’re planning a co-sell push in EMEA during October–November that bundles our deployment services with Redwood Dedicated trials for a set of 18 SI-led customers.

We’d like to request a syndicated promo allocation (partner-sourced credits) to seed 6 pilot customers (approx. 50k tokens each) plus an additional pool for demo/test accounts. High level: 350k token allocation and a 30-day trial extension for pilot orgs.

Can you point me to the right process/runbook to get this approved? We may need a quick legal note about tracking and voucher redemption windows. Attached is a short deck with the GTM plan.

Thanks — can loop in anyone on your side who owns partner promos.

Best,
Alice Ng
Head of Partnerships, LatticeCloud
alice@latticecloud.com
Attachment: LatticeCloud_MarketBundle_SOW.pdf (pdf)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Thanks Alice — appreciate the heads up. Looping in Ben (field sales) and Soojin (partner ops) who manage promo allocations and SI programs.

Quick asks to help the approval flow:
- Expected redemption profile: which customers (names/company), and are they new trial accounts or existing customers?
- Precise allocation request: token count per customer + demo pool amount (we need totals to route finance).
- Mutual action plan (MOP): success criteria, timeline, and lead owners.
- Any required legal/escrow language for partner-funded credits? Our standard is time-limited vouchers tied to account IDs; deviations need legal sign-off.

If you can drop a short CSV with the allocation per-customer that speeds things up. Ben/Soojin — adverse resource impacts? Any quota or SLA notes we should raise?

—Markus
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Thanks Markus / Alice — quick take from field: this cohort looks high-impact. Two practical items from sales ops:

1) We can greenlight ~350k tokens if the allocations are tied to named accounts and we get an internal redemption list.
2) For 30-day trial extensions, we need product to confirm there’s no billing edge-case for Dedicated reservations; if they convert we’ll need clear conversion steps.

Soojin — I’ll handoff runbook drafting to you. I’ll also open a HubSpot record and tag it LC-2026-0928 so finance has a reference.

Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Thanks Ben — attaching the per-customer allocation CSV and a short MOP. Summary: 6 pilots (each 50k tokens) = 300k tokens; 50k demo/test pool; total 350k tokens. Pilot accounts are all new trials (listed in CSV).

MOP highlights:
- Kickoff week of Oct 4; 30-day trials starting on activation
- Success metric: pilot converts to paid Dedicated or Hosted within 60 days of trial end (customer contact + purchase intent)
- Redwood commit: voucher activation and reporting on redemption weekly
- Lattice commit: named account introductions, 1x customer success touch per pilot

Attachment: promo-allocation-table.csv (csv)
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/xyz123

Would appreciate a short runbook with required fields (account id mapping, activation owner, expiration). We can also sign a short letter of intent to document the promo as partner-funded.

—Alice

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Appreciate the details, Alice. I started a draft runbook. Key ops checklist items I need confirmed before routing to finance/legal: 

1) Account mapping: provide Redwood account IDs for each named trial (CSV column). We cannot issue vouchers without account IDs.
2) Redemption window: confirm exact activation window (you stated kickoff wk Oct 4 — do you want vouchers valid Oct 4–Nov 15?)
3) SOC2/compliance evidence: for partner-funded credits we require partner data handling description; please share your SOC2 report or SSP excerpt (or point me to your compliance page).
4) Escrow/legal: if Lattice funds credits and wants escrowed handling, legal will need a one-pager. Recommend we use standard partner funding agreement template; if you need custom wording, legal lead will review and that will add ~3–5 business days.

I attached a short runbook template (internal). Once we have the CSV with account IDs and confirmation on dates I’ll route the finance ticket and create the voucher batch.

Soojin Lee
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: partner-runbook-template.docx (docx stub)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alice Ng <alice@latticecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Syndicated promo credit request for Q4 co-sell

Thanks team — quick executive decision: provisional approval for the 350k token syndicated allocation, conditional on:
- Receipt of CSV with Redwood account IDs by EOD Mon Oct 4
- Confirmation of activation/redemption window (Alice please confirm dates)
- SOC2 evidence or compliance page to satisfy ops
- Legal to approve standard partner-funding clause (Soojin to route)

Soojin/Ben: please file the finance ticket referencing deal LC-2026-0928 and set the voucher expiry to 45 days from activation to give pilots time to spin. Ben — keep me posted if any account requires change of region or Dedicated reservations.

Alice — thanks, we’ll prioritize this and aim for voucher issuance the first week of October once the items above land.

—Markus
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference
